name: Can I convert my propane grill to natural gas?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my propane grill to natural gas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many propane grills can be converted to natural gas, but it's not a universal guarantee. Conversion typically involves replacing the gas orifices, which control the flow of gas, and sometimes the regulator. Propane operates at a higher pressure than natural gas, so different components are necessary. It's important to use a conversion kit specifically designed for your grill model and to have the work done by a qualified technician. Attempting to convert a grill without the proper parts or expertise can be unsafe and may void your warranty.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many propane grills can be converted to natural gas by replacing orifices and regulators, but it requires a specific conversion kit and professional installation for safety.
